output.summary: The claim was denied because it was filed beyond the 90‑day limit. Gather any proof of timely filing, but note that the denial is considered final with no appeal basis.

items.text: Provide documentation proving the claim was submitted within 90 days of service, such as receipt timestamps or fax logs.
Obtain the required proof from the provider and submit it to the insurer for reconsideration, referencing clause 9.1.
Because the claim was filed 120 days after service, it exceeds the 90‑day filing limit, so there is no basis for an appeal under the policy.
